Done. All 1315 tests in the gson module pass (12 in `GsonBuilderTest`, including the two new FAIL_TO_PASS tests).

Changes made in `gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/GsonBuilder.java`:
- `registerTypeAdapter` (GsonBuilder.java:692) now throws `IllegalArgumentException("Cannot override built-in adapter for " + type)` when the type is `Object`, `JsonElement`, or any subclass, via the new `isTypeObjectOrJsonElement` helper (GsonBuilder.java:833).
- `registerTypeHierarchyAdapter` (GsonBuilder.java:861) throws the same exception when `baseType` is `JsonElement` or a subclass (registering a hierarchy adapter for `Object` remains allowed).
- Extended the Javadoc of both methods with `@throws` tags and a note that `@JsonAdapter` can be used as an alternative; also updated `UserGuide.md`.
